about.title: About
about.description: About Elver Tobo — Cloud Architect with 4+ years of experience designing AWS systems and practical AI solutions, with a security-first background. Open to remote roles.
about.body:
I position myself as a Cloud Architect focused on AWS and artificial intelligence. I currently work as a Security Developer at Fluid Attacks, where I bring a security-first mindset into cloud systems, infrastructure, and software delivery.

My background includes cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, serverless platforms, production debugging, secure software development, and reliable backend service design. I also use Cursor to accelerate my development workflow, improve code quality, explore solutions, and increase delivery speed while maintaining technical judgment and ownership of the code.

At Fluid Attacks I have built multiple features and worked across analytics, engineering, and incident management.

I'm especially interested in roles where I can design secure, scalable cloud architectures, integrate practical AI, improve reliability, and ship maintainable systems in production.

I work with AI-assisted software systems, including RAG applications and AI agents, with a practical focus on using AI to solve real business and engineering problems.

As a hobby and part of my personal brand, I enjoy writing articles on Medium. If you'd like to read them, you can find them at articles.etobo.tech.

Tech stack: Cursor, Python, FastAPI, AWS Lambda, S3, EC2, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, ECS, Bedrock, API Gateway, EventBridge, SNS, SSM, Terraform, Docker, GitLab, Git, Bash, LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith.
